method: Original page images read for explicit Suketi attributions, not automated keyword OCR
finding: These pages are explicitly Mandeali grammar; other varieties labeled Northern Mandeali/Chhota Banghal and comparative Hindi/Kashmiri. No additional explicit Suketi lexical attestation found. Shared two-State vocabulary remains separately inventoried on716–718.
policy: No transfer of Mandeali grammar or words into Suketi merely from close linguistic similarity.
